chapter_title_en: The Three Revolutions Heavy Origin Art
chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch.241 — The Three Revolutions Heavy Origin Art
chapter_meta_description: Han Li deciphers the Azure Origin Sword Art and discovers the Three Revolutions Heavy Origin Art—a technique that bypasses Core Formation by demanding three full cultivation dispersals.
og_title: RMJI 241: The Three Revolutions Heavy Origin Art
og_description: A 50% chance at Core Formation, but you must destroy your cultivation three times. Han Li accepts the gamble.
twitter_description: The Three Revolutions Heavy Origin Art: the ultimate Mortal Stream shortcut that asks you to break yourself three times.

lore_anchors.definition: A complete sword cultivation manual from Layer 1 to Layer 13, capable of reaching Spirit Transformation; the foundation for Han Li’s future growth.
An auxiliary technique that promises to bypass Core Formation by requiring the practitioner to disperse cultivation three times and rebuild from scratch.
The voluntary destruction of one’s cultivation base to revert to a lower state; normally catastrophic, but weaponized here as part of a compression strategy.
A set-type flying sword treasure requiring at least twelve wood-attributed swords, designed for Core Formation cultivators.
The cultivation stage above Core Formation and Nascent Soul, representing ultimate mastery over one’s spiritual essence.
The notoriously difficult wall that prevents most Foundation Establishment cultivators from advancing; bypassed here via the Three Revolutions technique.
The highest attainable state within Foundation Establishment, the prerequisite for attempting Core Formation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the Three Revolutions Heavy Origin Art require dispersing cultivation three times?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Each dispersion allows the practitioner to rebuild with compressed true essence, increasing purity each time until near-solid true essence makes Core Formation effortless.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the 50% success rate real or exaggerated?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The creator himself admits it is only a guess, but even a coin-flip chance is far better than the near-impossible odds for a cultivator with Han Li’s spiritual root endowment.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can’t Han Li just attempt normal Core Formation first?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He plans to try exactly that—cultivate to Foundation Establishment peak, attempt a normal breakthrough, and only disperse if that fails.
